pipe.startNote.en: C0 starts on GPU0. CPP runs 16 layers per stage and VPP runs eight. Both paths process all 64 layers.
pipe.startNote.zh-CN: GPU0 开始处理第一块。CPP 一次算 16 层，VPP 一次算 8 层。两种排程都要把这一块的 64 层算完。

pipe.fillNote.en: Each GPU starts as soon as its input arrives. GPU0 keeps admitting chunks. The VPP warmup counts are 7 / 5 / 3 / 1, so inner ranks begin the return leg first.
pipe.fillNote.zh-CN: GPU0 继续接收新块，后面的卡一拿到输入就开始算。GPU0 到 GPU3 分别先处理 7、5、3、1 个去程块，再接回程块。

pipe.turnNote.en: C0 reaches GPU3 and moves locally from S3 to S4. Older chunks start the return leg while newer ones move forward. Both legs share the compute stream on each rank.
pipe.turnNote.zh-CN: 第一个块 C0 在 GPU3 上算完 S3，接着算 S4，开始回程。这时，新块仍从 GPU0 向 GPU3 推进。

pipe.steadyNote.en: Each GPU alternates between an older chunk on the return leg and a newer chunk on the forward leg. Eight-layer stages let work on the second half of the network start earlier.
pipe.steadyNote.zh-CN: 每张卡轮流做两件事：算旧块在回程的 8 层，再算新块在去程的 8 层。

pipe.drainNote.en: All chunks have entered the pipeline. VPP finishes the remaining return stages. CPP still has to move the last, most expensive chunks through its physical stages.
pipe.drainNote.zh-CN: 所有块都已进入流水线。VPP 只需算完剩余的回程块。CPP 中，最后一个块还要逐卡经过后面的流水级。

pipe.uniformNote.en: With equal chunk costs, both schedules finish together. Select increasing costs to see how a growing KV history changes pipeline fill and drain.
pipe.uniformNote.zh-CN: 当各块耗时相同时，两种排程的总耗时也相同。把“每块耗时”切到“逐步增长”，可以看到后面的卡要多等多久。

pipe.growthNote.en: In this model CPP finishes at {0} u and VPP at {1} u. The amount of compute is the same. Stage size and local execution order determine the difference.
pipe.growthNote.zh-CN: 同样的计算量，CPP 用了 {0} u，VPP 用了 {1} u。图中以 CPP 第一级处理首块的时间为一个单位（u）。

dma.diagram.en: Segmented DMA events between GPU0 and GPU1
dma.diagram.zh-CN: GPU0 经主机缓冲区向 GPU1 传输数据的时间线

dma.readyNote.en: GPU0 records separate ready events for the residual and hidden planes. As each plane becomes ready, the host proxy thread can prepare its segments.
dma.readyNote.zh-CN: GPU0 分别记录残差和隐藏状态的就绪事件。每份输出算好后，主机代理线程就能安排相应的数据段传输。

dma.d2hNote.en: The host queues one segment's D2H copy and its completion event on the send stream, then publishes READY with the event generation the receiver should wait for.
dma.d2hNote.zh-CN: GPU0 的代理线程把一段数据的 D2H 拷贝和完成事件排入发送流，并发出 READY，告诉接收端这一次该等哪个事件。

dma.h2dNote.en: GPU1 queues Wait(D2H event) → H2D → H2D event, then publishes ACK. The copy engine starts H2D as soon as the D2H dependency is satisfied.
dma.h2dNote.zh-CN: GPU1 先把等待 D2H 完成、执行 H2D、记录完成事件排入接收流，再发出 ACK。上游拷贝完成时，GPU1 的拷贝引擎就能开始搬这一段。

dma.pipelineNote.en: D2H for one segment overlaps H2D for the previous segment. Eight host segments carry the full 160 MiB boundary in turns. Reusing a ring position requires its ACK and H2D completion.
dma.pipelineNote.zh-CN: 上游把下一段搬到主机时，下游可以同时取走上一段。160 MiB 的数据分十次经过主机上的八段缓冲。发送端收到对应的 ACK，并确认 H2D 已完成，就能复用那一段空间。

dma.receivedNote.en: GPU1 has the full input. Its compute stream passes the receive event and starts S1(C0). GPU0 has released its source slot after D2H, and this chunk has passed through the host ring.
dma.receivedNote.zh-CN: 整块输入到达 GPU1 后，计算流开始算 S1(C0)。此时 GPU0 已发完这块数据，可以复用输出槽。

dma.releaseNote.en: When S1(C0) finishes reading the input, its consumer event releases the receive slot. Source slots, host segments and receive slots become reusable at different points, each after its last reader finishes.
dma.releaseNote.zh-CN: 等 GPU1 算完 S1(C0)，接收槽就能给下一块使用。输出槽、主机缓冲区和接收槽的回收时间各自取决于最后一次读取何时结束。

load.uniformStart.en: With uniform context lengths the native split already balances work. The heaviest CTA in either schedule handles <strong>
load.uniformStart.zh-CN: 请求长度相同时，原生划分本来就很均匀。两种方法里，最忙的 CTA 都处理 <strong>

load.skewNote.en: Native splitting concentrates the long request on a few CTAs. The busiest handles {0} tiles. Global buckets assign about {1} tiles each and start a new task wherever a bucket crosses a request boundary.
load.skewNote.zh-CN: 原生划分把长请求交给少数 CTA，最忙的一个要处理 {0} 块。分桶后，每个 CTA 最多处理 {1} 块。同一个桶跨到下一个请求时，会新开一个子任务。

bucket.ctaPath.en: Each CTA executes its tasks in order within one launch
bucket.ctaPath.zh-CN: 每个 CTA 依次处理桶内的子任务

bucket.inside.zh-CN: 每个子任务的计算步骤

bucket.readTiles.zh-CN: 遍历分到的 KV 块

bucket.max.zh-CN: 170 个 CTA，每个最多处理 6 块

bucket.mergeTitle.en: Write one partial per task and merge by request
bucket.mergeTitle.zh-CN: 各子任务分别写出结果，再按请求合并

bucket.other.en: Other requests follow the same partial-to-merge path to their own outputs.
bucket.other.zh-CN: 其余请求也各自合并局部结果。

bucket.diagram.en: Step through KV tiles, tasks and buckets
bucket.diagram.zh-CN: 从 KV 分块到子任务分配，再到按请求合并结果

bucket.active.zh-CN: {0} 个 CTA 分到了工作

bucket.requestsNote.en: Read the KV lengths for this batch. Each request keeps its own Q, KV page table and output position.
bucket.requestsNote.zh-CN: 每个请求都有自己的 Q、KV 页表和输出位置。分桶先读取这一批请求各自的 KV 长度。

bucket.tilesNote.en: Count tiles in units of 256 tokens, then compute their global prefix offsets. Each tile retains its request ID. KV data stays in the paged cache.
bucket.tilesNote.zh-CN: 每 256 个 token 划为一个 KV 块。把各请求的块数依次累加，就能算出每个请求的起止编号。调度只用这些编号，KV 数据仍在原来的缓存页里。

bucket.packNote.en: Each bucket has a budget of {0} tiles. CTA {1} has {2} task(s){3}
bucket.packNote.zh-CN: 每桶最多装 {0} 块 KV。CTA {1} 分到 {2} 个子任务{3}

bucket.cross.en: because its range crosses a request boundary.

bucket.runNote.en: A CTA walks its bucket in task order. All tiles in a task share an online softmax accumulator. Finishing the task publishes one partial result.
bucket.runNote.zh-CN: 每个 CTA 依次执行桶内的子任务。在一个子任务内，每处理一个 KV 块就更新一次在线 softmax，处理完最后一块才写出局部结果。

bucket.mergeNote.en: A counter collects partials for each request. The CTA that finishes the last task reads all its partials and writes the final O. A single-task request writes O directly.
bucket.mergeNote.zh-CN: 每个请求单独计数。最后完成子任务的 CTA 读取该请求的全部局部结果，合并得到 O。如果整个请求只有一个子任务，就直接写出 O。

bucket.table.zh-CN: <table><thead><tr><th>子任务</th><th>请求</th><th>KV 块区间</th><th>块数</th><th>桶 / CTA</th></tr></thead><tbody>

merge.reweight.en: Read 5 partials → reweight by softmax mass
merge.reweight.zh-CN: 读取五份局部结果，重新计算权重

merge.order.en: Finish order: T2 → T0 → T4 → T3 → T1
merge.order.zh-CN: 完成顺序：T2 → T0 → T4 → T3 → T1

merge.reset.zh-CN: 写出结果，本轮计数复位

merge.publish.en: Each finisher publishes its own partial
merge.publish.zh-CN: 各子任务写入各自的结果槽

merge.diagram.en: Five tasks publish partials in completion order and the last CTA merges them
merge.diagram.zh-CN: 五个子任务陆续完成，最后一个 CTA 合并结果

merge.startNote.en: R0 has five tasks on different CTAs. Each has its own scratch slot.
merge.startNote.zh-CN: 请求 R0 分成五个子任务，分别在不同 CTA 上执行。每个子任务在显存里都有自己的结果槽。

merge.t2Note.en: T2 finishes first, stores O₂, m₂ and l₂, then increments the completion count for R0.
merge.t2Note.zh-CN: T2 最先完成。它写入 O₂、m₂ 和 l₂，再给 R0 的完成计数加一。

merge.t0Note.en: T0 finishes. Two partials are ready in scratch while the other tasks keep running.
merge.t0Note.zh-CN: T0 也算完了。现在有两份局部结果可以读取，另外三个子任务还在算。

merge.t4Note.en: T4 has finished. T3 and T1 are still running. Completion order determines which CTA will merge the results.
merge.t4Note.zh-CN: T4 写入第三份结果。T3 和 T1 还在算，谁最后完成就由谁合并。

merge.t3Note.en: Four partials are ready. The CTA running T1 is finishing the last task.
merge.t3Note.zh-CN: T3 写入第四份结果，只剩 T1。

merge.t1Note.en: T1 increments the counter and sees the previous value 4. As the last finisher it reads all five partials, reweights them by softmax mass and writes O_R0.
merge.t1Note.zh-CN: T1 更新计数时读到旧值 4，知道自己是第五个。它读出五份局部结果，按各自的 softmax 权重合并，写出请求 R0 的输出。

norm.inputNote.en: Read x, the residual and the norm weights. One CTA adds the residual and reduces the sum of squares across a row of 5,120 elements.
norm.inputNote.zh-CN: 一个 CTA 处理一行 5120 个元素。它读取输入、残差和归一化权重，先做残差加法，再对一行的平方和做归约。

norm.fusedNote.en: Each warp reduces its sum of squares by shuffle. Ten FP32 partials meet in shared memory; warp 0 computes the inverse RMS. Each thread rounds 16 normalized values to BF16 and packs them with one E4M3 scale.
norm.fusedNote.zh-CN: 每个 warp 先用 shuffle 求出自己的部分和。10 个 FP32 部分和写入共享内存，由 warp 0 汇总并计算均方根的倒数。每个线程把 16 个归一化结果舍入为 BF16，再用同一个 E4M3 缩放因子打包成 FP4。

norm.nativeNote.en: Add and RMSNorm produce BF16 y. A separate quantizer reads that tensor and packs it into NVFP4.
norm.nativeNote.zh-CN: 残差相加和 RMSNorm 先算出 BF16 张量 y，写入全局内存。随后量化算子重新读取 y，打包成 NVFP4。

norm.outNote.en: The kernel writes the BF16 residual, packed FP4 values and native-layout scales. The MLP GEMM reads the packed input directly.
norm.outNote.zh-CN: 融合算子写出更新后的 BF16 残差、打包好的 FP4 值和按原有布局排列的缩放因子。MLP 可以直接读取这份输入做矩阵乘法。

norm.unfusedOut.en: The BF16 residual is retained. A separate quantization stage supplies packed FP4 and scales to the MLP GEMM.
norm.unfusedOut.zh-CN: 残差以 BF16 写出。另一个量化算子写出 FP4 值和缩放因子，供 MLP 读取。

front.inputNote.en: Read the QKV projection outputs, positions, slot mapping and quantization scales. The Q side also supplies the gate used after attention.
front.inputNote.zh-CN: 输入包括 QKV 投影结果、位置、缓存槽位和量化缩放因子。Q 分支还带有后面要用的门控值。

front.fusedNote.en: One 128-thread CTA handles a token and a Q or K head. Four warps combine their sums through shared memory. On the K path, rotated values feed the FP4 packer directly. V is read from the projection and packed for the same cache slot.
front.fusedNote.zh-CN: 每个 CTA 有 128 个线程，处理一个 token 的一个 Q 头或 K 头。四个 warp 通过共享内存合并平方和。K 旋转后立即打包成 FP4，V 则从投影结果直接量化。二者写到同一个 token 对应的缓存位置。

front.nativeNote.en: Q and K first undergo their per-head transforms. A subsequent quantize-and-append stage reads K and V and writes their pages.
front.nativeNote.zh-CN: 先对 Q 和 K 做归一化和旋转，写出中间结果。后续算子再读取 K 和 V，量化后追加到分页 KV 缓存。

front.outNote.en: Attention receives BF16 Q and the gate, plus NVFP4 K/V and scales in the paged cache. It reads the existing page table and native data layout.
front.outNote.zh-CN: 算子写出 BF16 的 Q 和门控值，并把 NVFP4 的 K/V 和缩放因子写到缓存页。XQA 仍可用原有页表读取它们。

tail.inputNote.en: A single task produces O directly. With multiple tasks the last CTA merges their partials. At this point the softmax reduction covers the request's full KV range.
tail.inputNote.zh-CN: 只有一个子任务时，它直接算出注意力输出 O。有多个子任务时，最后完成的 CTA 先合并整个请求的局部结果，得到 O。

tail.fusedNote.en: The final writer applies BF16 sigmoid(gate), a BF16 multiply and static FP8 quantization in sequence to produce the projection input.
tail.fusedNote.zh-CN: 写出 O 的线程接着计算 sigmoid 门控，按 BF16 舍入并相乘，再用固定的缩放因子量化成 FP8，供输出投影直接读取。

tail.nativeNote.en: Attention stores BF16 O. The native compiled epilogue reads it, applies the gate and quantizes to FP8.
tail.nativeNote.zh-CN: 注意力算子先写出 BF16 的 O。后续算子重新读入 O，乘上门控值，再量化成 FP8。

tail.outNote.en: The final store writes E4M3 FP8 directly for the output projection. Partial computation and merging keep their existing formats.
tail.outNote.zh-CN: E4M3 格式的 FP8 输出可直接用于输出投影。各分片仍按原来的精度计算和合并局部结果。

tail.unfusedOut.en: The epilogue writes the FP8 tensor consumed by the output projection.
tail.unfusedOut.zh-CN: 后续算子写出 FP8 张量，输出投影再读入它。
